This '''Mandalorian warship''' was part of the Neo-Crusader [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR17" />

==Characteristics==
The dagger-shaped class was similar in appearance to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] produced millennia later for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
The vessel was armed with anti-[[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] missiles.<ref name="KOTOR17" />

It had at least four main thrusters, arranged similarly to the later ''Venator''-class<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> and several small auxiliary thrusters. Given it successfully pursued the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']] from the battlefield, its top speed was the same or greater than the [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class]].<ref name="KOTOR17" />

==History==
During the retreat from the [[Battle of Serroco]], the remains of the [[Battle Group Serroco|''Courageous'' battle group]] were attacked by several of these ships, along with Mandalorian boarding craft.<ref name="KOTOR17" />

==Appearances==
*[[Knights of the Old Republic 17|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 17]]
